# bitbucket_group_membership (Resource)

Adds a user to a workspace group. One resource per user; add one of these per member you want in the group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bitbucket_group_membership" "jcardenas" {
  group_slug = bitbucket_group.release_managers.slug
  user       = "jcardenas"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_slug` (String) Slug of the group to add the user to.
- `user` (String) UUID or username of the user to add to the group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier, formatted as "workspace/group_slug/user".

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import bitbucket_group_membership.jcardenas release-managers/jcardenas
```
